, s.m. (f. -ī), A goose, gander; swan; duck; — flamingo; — the living soul; — one of the vital airs; — an epithet of Brahmā; of Vishṇu; of Śiva; of Kām-dev; of the Sun; of an unambitious and liberal monarch; of an asceti
(fr. haṅsnā, q.v.), s.m. Laughing; laughter (see haṅsī): — haṅs-mukh, adj. Of a laughing countenance, merry-faced, smiling, cheerful, blithesome, merry, jovial, jolly; facetious, jocular.
[S. त्र्हेषा], s.f. (dialec.) Neighing (of a horse).
, s.f. = halas = haris, qq.v.
(rt. hu), s.m. Oblation, burnt-offering, sacrifice.
(rt. hve), s.m. Calling, call; invitation; invocation; — challenge; — order, command.
(dialec.), emphat. part. 1˚ = hī, q.v.; — 2˚ = bhī, q.v.
[Ap. Prk. ˚हू or ˚ह; Prk. ˚ह; S. ˚थ], A com. sign, in old Hindī, of the 2nd pers. pl. of the imperat. (e.g. हसहु ( = हंसो) = Prk. हसहु or हसह = S. हसथ).

[ho˚ = Prk. हो(इ), or हुव(इ), or हव(इ) or भव(इ) = S. भव(ति), rt. भू], v n. To be, to exist; to subsist; to be born; to become; to attain (to); — to come; to accrue, result; to be effected, be accomplished; to be committe

(1˚ for A. هَوَاءِ, fr. هَوَي 'to blow,' &c.; — 2˚ for A. هَوًي, fr. هَوِيَ 'to love'), s.f. Air, atmosphere, ether, the space between heaven and earth; — air, wind, gentle gale; — a gas; — flight; — an aerial being; spi
[prob. Ap. Prk. हऊअं; S. भूत+कं, rt. भू], s.m. A bugaboo, bugbear; a hobgoblin, an ogre.

[Ap. Prk. हुआ (for हुइआ), Prk. भविदओ = S. भव (fr. भू)+इत+कः], perf. part. (of honā; f. huʼī), Become; (as a finite verb) became; has become; was; — happened; passed, or has passed (and hence it may often be rendered 'sin
, 1˚ part. f. (dialec.) = hotī (fem. of hotā, q.v.); — 2˚ s.f. = hot.

[ho˚ = Prk. हो(इ), or हुव(इ), or हव(इ) or भव(इ) = S. भव(ति), rt. भू], v n. To be, to exist; to subsist; to be born; to become; to attain (to); — to come; to accrue, result; to be effected, be accomplished; to be committe
, s.m. An oblation (to the gods), a burnt-offering, sacrifice.

[Prk. हुं; S. हुम् or हूम्], adv. Yes, well, very well; exactly; proceed; — humph; — avaunt! away! begone! down with him! — a mystical syllable (of frequent occurrence in spells and incantations): — hūṅ karnā, To say 'ye
[Prk. वि or पि; S. अपि], emphat. adv. (also expletive), Too, also, even, &c. (i.q. bhī, and hī).
(Kanaujī), or हौं hauṅ (Braj) [Ap. Prk. हउं, हमु; Prk. अहं, हअं; S. अहम्], pron. I: — hauṅ-hū, or hauṅ-hūṅ, I too, I also (i.q. maiṅ-bhī).
, s.f. = هٿهہ haṭh, q.v.
(imperat., 2nd pers. sing. of haṭnā, q.v.), intj. Out of the way! out upon you! away with you!
, s.m. A market, &c. (i.q. hāṭ, q.v.).

[prob. fr. S. एव; Prk. वेअ or विअ; — or perhaps akin to S. हि], emphat. adv. aff. Just, very, exactly, indeed, truly, only, alone, merely, solely, altogether, outright; — own; self; — (with inflected imperfect part.) imm
(i.q. hāy, or hāʼe, the more com. form in Hindī), intj. Ah! alas! strange! wonderful! eh! ha!: — hai-hai, or haʼe-haʼe, Alas, alas! alack-a-day! alas the day! well-a-day!

[old H. (2nd pers. sing.) ahasi, ahahi, or hai; Prk. prob. अहहि = S. अस्+असि (cf. hūṅ); — old H. (3rd pers. sing.) ahaʼi, or ahai; prob. Prk. अहइ = S. अस्+अति], (Thou) art; — (he, she, or it) is; — he (in Braj also) = ʻw

, s.m. A horse; — the Yak or Bos grunniens; — a man of a particular class; an epithet of Indra: — hayāśanā (˚ya+aś˚), s.f. 'Horse-food'; the gum-olibanum tree: — hay-pradhān, s.m. Chief horse; — chief horseman; — master
, emphat. adv. = هي hī, q.v.; — (in Braj) case-affix of the dat. & acc. (i.q. hi; and = ko).
[old H. ahahiṅ or hahiṅ; Prk. prob. अहहिं; S. अस्+अन्ति, by change of class; cf. hai], (They) are.

, = H هينا हीना hīnā [S. हीन+कः], part. adj. (rt. hā), Left, forsaken, quitted, abandoned, deserted; excluded, shut out; deprived (of, -se), bereft (of), devoid, destitute; without (often added to substantives to form ad

[prob. fr. S. एव; Prk. वेअ or विअ; — or perhaps akin to S. हि], emphat. adv. aff. Just, very, exactly, indeed, truly, only, alone, merely, solely, altogether, outright; — own; self; — (with inflected imperfect part.) imm
[Prk. & S. हे], vocat. part. O! oh!: — he-re, Ho!
, pron. (dialec. Bhojpūrī), This, &c. (i.q. yah).

[old H. (2nd pers. sing.) ahasi, ahahi, or hai; Prk. prob. अहहि = S. अस्+असि (cf. hūṅ); — old H. (3rd pers. sing.) ahaʼi, or ahai; prob. Prk. अहइ = S. अस्+अति], (Thou) art; — (he, she, or it) is; — he (in Braj also) = ʻw

[contrac. of yā-hi = Ap. Prk. ए = एव = S. इयत् (Vedic ईवत्)+hi = Ap. Prk. हे = S. अस्य, gen. aff.], 1˚ the base (in Braj.) of the obl. cases of the pron. yah, q.v. (and = is); — 2˚ a corr. of yah (or of e): — yā-par = is
, adv. = yāṅ = yahāṅ, 'here,' (used in comp.): — yā-te, or yā-teṅ, or yā-soṅ (dialec.) = yahāṅ-se.
[Parsī ayāv; Zend atha vā; S. अथवा; — Hindī also या yā, from the Urdū], conj. Or; either: — yā-to, conj. Either: — yā — yā, or yā-to — yā, or yā-to — athwā, conj. Either-or: — yā-ki, conj. Either.
(A. also yā), intj. O! oh!: — yā allāh, or yāʼllāh, O God!: — yā rabb, O Lord!: — yā qismat, or yā naṣīb, Oh destiny! (an exclamation of one who in distress resigns himself to the will of God).

, s.f. Remembrance, recollection; memory: — yād-allāh, s.m. Compliments, greeting; — a form of salutation between faqīrs: — yād-ash ba-ḵẖair, Whom God remember graciously; God preserve him (used when speaking of an absen
(yah, q.v.+ī = hī, q.v.), emphat. pron. This very, this same, the very same (person or thing); — this even.
